intro.text: A group of scientists who seek to understand the mysteries of the cosmere and claim neutrality in interplanetary conflicts.

description.text: TimeTellers wear small triangular metal ornaments, enamelled in red, on the sides of their faces.
Nomad suspects they are secretly an arm of the Malwish military, developing technology to stay ahead in a growing interplanetary arms race.

items.text: A group of TimeTellers came to Canticle to study its sun and core and how the two interact.
They tried to hire Nomad as a mercenary. Having worked with the Cinder King, they refused to help Beacon's people.
One of their scientists, studying how to move Investiture between sunhearts, told Nomad they had recharged one.
